seo.imageAlt: Authentic Middle Eastern falafel plate with crispy falafel, creamy tahini sauce, fresh salad, and pita bread.
seo.imageCaption: Whip up this vibrant and delicious authentic falafel plate, complete with homemade crispy falafel and a drizzle of rich tahini sauce!

description: Savor the authentic taste of the Middle East with this vibrant falafel vegetarian plate. Crispy on the outside and tender inside, these homemade falafel are perfectly paired with a creamy tahini sauce, fresh salad, and warm pita bread. It is a satisfying and wholesome meal that captures the essence of traditional flavors.

instructions.title: Prepare Chickpeas and Falafel Mixture
instructions.text: Drain the soaked chickpeas thoroughly. In a food processor, combine the drained chickpeas, chopped onion, parsley, cilantro, and garlic cloves. Pulse until the mixture is finely ground but still has some texture. Do not over-process into a paste.

instructions.title: Season and Form Falafel
instructions.text: Transfer the chickpea mixture to a large bowl. Add the flour, baking powder, cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper (if using), salt, and black pepper. Mix well until everything is evenly combined. The mixture should be firm enough to hold its shape. If too wet, add a little more flour. Form the mixture into small patties or balls, about 1.5 inches in diameter.

instructions.title: Heat Oil and Fry Falafel
instructions.text: In a deep pot or Dutch oven, heat the vegetable oil to 350F (175C). Carefully drop a few falafel patties into the hot oil, ensuring not to overcrowd the pot. Fry for 3-5 minutes, turning occasionally, until they are deep golden brown and crispy on all sides.

instructions.title: Drain and Keep Warm
instructions.text: Using a slotted spoon, remove the cooked falafel from the oil and place them on a plate lined with paper towels to drain excess oil. Repeat with the remaining falafel mixture. Keep the cooked falafel warm while you prepare the tahini sauce and assemble the plates.

instructions.title: Prepare Tahini Sauce
instructions.text: In a small bowl, whisk together the tahini, fresh lemon juice, minced garlic, and salt. Gradually add cold water, starting with 1/4 cup, whisking continuously until the sauce reaches a smooth, creamy, and pourable consistency. Add more water if needed to thin it out.

instructions.title: Assemble and Serve
instructions.text: Arrange the crispy falafel on a serving platter or individual plates. Serve with warm pita bread, diced tomatoes, cucumbers, shredded lettuce, and pickled turnips or pickles. Drizzle generously with the homemade tahini sauce. Offer extra sauce on the side for dipping. Enjoy immediately.

tips: For truly authentic falafel, use dried chickpeas soaked overnight, never canned, as they yield a superior texture and flavor.
Adjust the consistency of your tahini sauce by gradually adding cold water until it reaches a smooth, pourable, yet creamy texture.
Serve falafel immediately after frying to enjoy their maximum crispiness. Pair with fresh pita, a simple salad, and plenty of tahini sauce.
